title: Holographic Krylov complexity in the Coulomb branch of ${\cal N}=4$ SYM
summary: We study holographic Krylov complexity in the Coulomb branch of ${\cal N}=4$ SYM. Adopting the proposal that the time derivative of the Krylov complexity is dual to the proper radial momentum of a massive particle, we investigate two probe geodesics within this geometry. For one of the radial trajectories we obtain exact analytic results, even when additional motion in the internal space is included.
